main.description: A unified record type for things the author has made: illustrations, articles, videos, talks, newsletters, podcasts. The kind field discriminates the variant; type-specific fields (media, event, series) are optional sub-objects. Long-form blog posts and newsletters whose body lives elsewhere (e.g., site.standard.document on Offprint) should use canonicalUrl rather than body.

kind.description: Discriminator for the content variant. Closed enum in v1; adding new kinds requires a lexicon update.

kindLabel.description: Optional user-supplied label shown alongside the kind. Most useful when kind is 'other' to describe what the content actually is (e.g. 'zine', 'recipe', 'sticker pack'). Renderers should prefer this label when present and the kind is 'other'.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier renderers can use to build stable, human-readable URLs for this content (e.g. `/illustrations/my-zine`). Optional; renderers should fall back to the rkey or another identifier when omitted. Useful when migrating existing content so old URLs don't break.

description.description: Short markdown summary, abstract, or caption. Appropriate for previews and feeds.

body.description: Full markdown content when this record holds the content itself. Omit when the content lives elsewhere (use canonicalUrl).

publishedAt.description: When this piece of content was originally published.

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical URL where the content originally lives (e.g., a YouTube video, a github.blog article, a podcast episode page). When set, renderers should link readers to this URL as the primary destination.

imageAlt.description: Alt text describing the image for screen readers and renderers that need a text fallback.

tags.description: Freeform tags shared across all content kinds. Enables cross-kind filtering.

media.description: Type-specific media references (audio, video, slides, duration). Used by video, podcast, talk.

series.description: Series metadata. Used by podcast, newsletter.

bskyPostRef.description: Strong reference to a Bluesky post. Useful for off-platform comments, or to crosslink an illustration / article / video / talk to its announcement post.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was first created in the user's PDS.

media.description: Type-specific media URLs and duration. All fields optional; populate whichever apply to the content kind.

audioUrl.description: URL of an audio file (used by podcast).

videoUrl.description: URL of a video recording (used by video, talk).

slidesUrl.description: URL of a slide deck (used by talk).

duration.description: Duration in seconds (used by video, podcast, talk).

name.description: Name of the conference or event.

eventRef.description: AT-URI of the community.lexicon.calendar.event record, if one exists.

series.description: Series metadata for a podcast or newsletter.

name.description: Name of the show or publication (e.g., 'Overcommitted', 'The Balanced Engineer').

episodeNumber.description: Episode or issue number within the series.

season.description: Season number, if the series uses seasons.

feedUrl.description: Canonical RSS or Atom feed URL for the series.
